description: Review changed code and available scanner reports for security risks and prioritize remediation.

Use the `security-checks` skill. Review the current diff and any scanner reports I provide. Identify confirmed issues separately from potential risks and false-positive candidates. Include severity, source evidence, practical impact, remediation, and tests. Do not expose secret values. Do not claim that a scanner ran unless you ran it or its report is present. Do not perform exploitation or modify files.
